reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in his direct message. On 14 Oct he told me his standing call with the Quarrendon Freight Lines team is **Thursdays at 16:30** from then on.

I found this in two places: our direct message history with him, and the private note saved under his name in gbrain. Both say the same thing. He never gave a length or end time for the call, and I said so in the reply. I didn't touch his calendar.
